task: Look at what blaze draws on a real terminal from an ix VM
do: Run it in a detached tmux pane of the size wanted (tmux new-session -d -x 80 -y 24), capture the pane as text every 0.4 s (tmux capture-pane -p), and at the end capture with history (-S -300): the history shows what the screen left behind, which the visible pane does not.
why: Every visible frame looked right while tmux's history held a copy of the region per frame (annoyance termui-1): only the history capture showed it.
